checks.name: local-paths
checks.run: if git grep -nE '(^|[^A-Za-z0-9_])/(home|tmp)/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+' -- ':!*.png' ':!*.jpg' ':!internal/policy/testdata/candidate-uri-cases.json'; then echo 'a machine-local path is in tracked text'; exit 1; fi

checks.name: go-fmt
checks.run: unformatted=$(gofmt -l $(go list -f '{{.Dir}}' ./...)); if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then echo 'not gofmt-formatted:'; echo "$unformatted"; exit 1; fi

checks.name: startup-fmt
checks.run: unformatted=$(gofmt -l .); if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then echo 'not gofmt-formatted:'; echo "$unformatted"; exit 1; fi

checks.name: startup-test
checks.run: profile=$(mktemp) && trap 'rm -f "$profile"' EXIT && go test -coverprofile="$profile" ./... && total=$(go tool cover -func="$profile" | awk '$1 == "total:" {sub(/%/, "", $NF); print $NF}') && echo "startup coverage: ${total}% of statements (floor 90%)" && awk -v total="$total" 'BEGIN { exit !(total ~ /^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$/ && total + 0 >= 90) }'

checks.name: emit-coverage
checks.run: profile=$(mktemp) && trap 'rm -f "$profile"' EXIT && go test -coverprofile="$profile" ./internal/emit/ && total=$(go tool cover -func="$profile" | awk '$1 == "total:" {sub(/%/, "", $NF); print $NF}') && echo "emit coverage: ${total}% of statements (floor 90%)" && awk -v total="$total" 'BEGIN { exit !(total ~ /^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$/ && total + 0 >= 90) }'

checks.name: coverage-floors
checks.run: profile=$(mktemp) && trap 'rm -f "$profile"' EXIT && status=0 && for pkg in internal/registry internal/emit/conformance internal/terraformfile internal/jcs cmd/jpack-emit-go-facts cmd/jpack-emit-go-loader cmd/jpack-emit-ts-constants; do go test -coverprofile="$profile" "./$pkg" || { status=1; continue; }; total=$(go tool cover -func="$profile" | awk '$1 == "total:" {sub(/%/, "", $NF); print $NF}'); echo "$pkg coverage: ${total}% of statements (floor 90%)"; awk -v total="$total" 'BEGIN { exit !(total ~ /^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?$/ && total + 0 >= 90) }' || { echo "$pkg is below the 90% floor"; status=1; }; done; exit $status
